name: Paradev
description: Paradev is an open-source Codex App and Conductor alternative. Orchestrate an army coding agents in parallel with your own subscriptions.

issues.title: [feat] Add a platform-level layer above Project to group multiple repos
Let me name a workspace and its branch when I create it
[perf] Severe input lag from excessive git subprocesses across all open workspaces
Be able to specify worktree and branch name
[bug] Codex update prompt loops infinitely: update exits to bare shell, re-launch shows same update
Feature: host-advertised direct connection URL (relay brokers, client connects directly over LAN/Tailscale)
App constantly freezes and turns into blank state

latest_release.name: Paradev Desktop desktop-v2.0.8
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(cloud): keep Codex ChatGPT sign-ins alive in cloud workspaces by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9290
* feat(models): add Claude Fable 5.2 by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9568
* fix(marketing): stop CCing the submitter on contact form emails by @saddlepaddle in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9567
* fix: workspace moves skip empty chats, explain failures once, and resume after a reload by @harshithmullapudi in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9561
* feat(desktop): a cloud workspace opens on its chats while its box wakes by @harshithmullapudi in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9565
* fix: show every open chat on desktop and mobile, not only chats with a running agent by @harshithmullapudi in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9570
* chore(desktop): bump version to 2.0.7 by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9557
* feat(desktop): every sidebar card can be dismissed, and no em dashes in desktop UI by @Kitenite in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9573
* feat(chat): show why Claude asks for approval in Full access by @harshithmullapudi in https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/pull/9574


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ParadevAI/Paradev/compare/desktop-v2.0.7...desktop-v2.0.8
